title: The Ridge at the Limit Where Fire Becomes Glass

features.name: burnt-homestead

inscription: at this heat, stone learns it was always glass, waiting; fire does not destroy but reveals what was already true.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the fire revealing itself
narr: You both watched the ridge heat until stone began to
lose the argument with fire. She said the archive would
need to burn someday too, to learn what it really held.
The glass pooled between you like an answer that took
fire to speak. You understood: transformation is truth.
